publicationTitle: 2009 Digest of Technical Papers International Conference on Consumer Electronics
abstract: For the seamless video streaming, the bandwidth variation should be considered to control the transmission rate. The packet pair probing technique (PPPT) can be utilized to measure the bandwidth of the network. To adapt the PPPT to the video streaming over the high speed downlink packet access (HSDPA), we experimentally investigate the relationship between the actual available bandwidth (AB) of the HSDPA network and the channel capacity estimated by the PPPT. Using this relationship, we propose an efficient real-time video streaming method. Experimental results show that the proposed method improves the performance of the video streaming over the HSDPA network.

articleTitle: An efficient multimedia file system for NAND flash memory storage
publicationTitle: 2009 Digest of Technical Papers International Conference on Consumer Electronics
abstract: This paper suggests a way to decrease memory usage through data management in segment units for the effective processing of multimedia files. In addition, it suggests a proper indexing structure and garbage collection method for multimedia files to improve performances of mounting and wear leveling.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of long-range RFID reader for sensor tag system
publicationTitle: 2009 Digest of Technical Papers International Conference on Consumer Electronics
abstract: ISO/IEC 24753 defines new modem specifications for long-range RFID communications and application protocol for sensor tag system. According to the ISO/IEC 24753, the frequency offset of the tag is 4%. In this paper, we designed a non-coherent receiver structure to solve the frequency offset problem. A frequency estimation block was designed to mitigate the effects of 4% frequency offset and a start frame delimiter (SFD) detection algorithm was proposed to determine the start position of the payload. We implemented a long-range RFID reader with the proposed methods and evaluated its performance in a wired network. The implemented long-range RFID reader showed more superior performance than the commercial RFID reader.

articleTitle: Area efficient and high throughput CAVLC encoder for 1920×1080@30p H.264/AVC
publicationTitle: 2009 Digest of Technical Papers International Conference on Consumer Electronics
abstract: This paper proposes a high performance hardware architecture design for the H.264/AVC CAVLC encoder. The proposed architecture can make a realtime process for 1920×1080 @ 30p. With the synthesis constraint of a 114MHz clock, the hardware cost of the proposed design is 7389 gates based on SS65LP 65nm technology.

articleTitle: Integrated measurement and analysis system for digital broadcasting
publicationTitle: 2009 Digest of Technical Papers International Conference on Consumer Electronics
abstract: To manage numerous field test data of digital broadcasting systems efficiently, field measurement systems have been integrated and become more intelligent. In this paper, we present the Integrated Measurement and Analysis System (IMAS) which manages DTV and T-DMB (Terrestrial Digital Multimedia Broadcasting) test data very efficiently. This system can measure various parameters of DTV, T-DMB as well as Analog TV (ATV) and FM broadcasting in fixed or mobile measurement mode. All the test equipments are connected through the local area network and managed by the system controller with an open device interface. Every test result can be converted into specific standard formats and stored in the main data base which can be accessed with a web graphical user interface through the intranet.

articleTitle: Bandwidth reduced H.264/AVC hardware design with various windows of lossless compressor and cache scheme
publicationTitle: 2009 Digest of Technical Papers International Conference on Consumer Electronics
abstract: The bus bandwidth insufficiency and the real-time processing of H.264/AVC are the most serious problems in High Definition (HD) or Ultra Definition (UD) video data. This paper presents the bandwidth reduced architecture to solve these problems. By using various windows of lossless compressor and cache scheme with each controller, we can significantly reduce both data bandwidth and processing cycles.

articleTitle: Increasing the storage density for a 4th-Generation Optical Disc
publicationTitle: 2009 Digest of Technical Papers International Conference on Consumer Electronics
abstract: While CD, DVD and Blu-ray disc (BD) are on the market, attempts are being made by industry and research facilities to further increase the storage density for the next or 4th generation of optical storage. The objective is an increase by a factor of 3...4 compared to BD. The European funded project MobileDrive/4GOOD (4th-Generation, omni-purpose optical disc-system) chose the super-resolution near-field structure (SuperRENS) technology as the basis to decrease the minimum mark length as well as the track pitch on the disc. The contribution emphasises the steps taken in disc development and signal processing, and the results achieved so far. Disc development covers the layer stack of the disc and materials for the layers, especially comparison of different materials for the SuperRENS layer. Signal processing methods include clock recovery, bit detection, demodulation and inner and outer forward error correction.

articleTitle: Low-complexity intra-prediction for H.264/AVC using pseudo local decoded image
publicationTitle: 2009 Digest of Technical Papers International Conference on Consumer Electronics
abstract: This paper presents a method of low-complexity intra-prediction for H.264/AVC that uses pseudo local decoded image (PLDI). The PLDI is created using a Hadamard transform and used for intra-prediction mode decision. Our experimental results show that the proposed method can reduce the complexity of the intra-prediction process with acceptable losses in picture quality.

articleTitle: Hierarchical CRGK for a large-scale user group
publicationTitle: 2009 Digest of Technical Papers International Conference on Consumer Electronics
abstract: The purpose of the group key management is to provide a secure key sharing scheme among the users in a group on a broadcast or a multicast environment. CRGK[1] is the centralized group key management scheme based on the Chinese remainder theorem (CRT). It optimizes the number of rekey message, user-side key computation, and number of key storage. However, CRGK is suited for a small size user group because of the computation complexity of the Chinese remainder theorem. In this paper, we propose a hierarchical CRGK scheme which is able to support a large-scale user group. Our approach is to adopt an n-ary tree with the CRGK. Our scheme requires the small number of re-key messages and the short computation time even though the size of a user group increases largely.

articleTitle: Distance tracking for the remote control of an MP3 player
publicationTitle: 2009 Digest of Technical Papers International Conference on Consumer Electronics
abstract: In this paper we propose a design with low-power and distance tracking for both a remote control board and a monitor board for an MP3 player. The design consists of a microprocessor, a GPS module, an RF module, 6 tyco switches and a 2times16 LCD display enabling the user to use all functions. Our remote control board supports the function key of a typical MP3 player with 27 functions. In addition this design detects longitude and latitude outdoors which are received by the monitor board through the GPS and the RF module. The remote control board also receives longitude and latitude. After the monitor board receives the longitude and latitude data of the remote control board, it determines the distance between the two boards and shows this in an LCD display which allows the user to track an MP3 player user at any time. When the GPS can't detect a signal from a satellite we use the RSSI (Receive Signal Strength Indicator) register in the RF module to measure the distance between the two boards.

articleTitle: Efficient implementation of adaptive interpolation filters for low complexity video coding
publicationTitle: 2009 Digest of Technical Papers International Conference on Consumer Electronics
abstract: This paper presents novel methods for implementing adaptive interpolation filtering techniques for video coding on 16-bit integer architectures. Proposed methods offer significant complexity reduction, especially valuable for resource constrained mobile multimedia devices, with high coding efficiency.

articleTitle: Intuitive appliance control system with ID acquisition
publicationTitle: 2009 Digest of Technical Papers International Conference on Consumer Electronics
abstract: This paper describes an appliance control system that uses the IDs of the user and the appliances. The system uses knowledge of appliance functionality and the user's need to simplify and unify the control processes performed by the user. Usability experiments conducted on a presentation system show the advantage of the system.

articleTitle: Adaptive stretched-out coding based on cumulative histogram analysis for reduction of GSR error and DFC in plasma TV
publicationTitle: 2009 Digest of Technical Papers International Conference on Consumer Electronics
abstract: Like MPD-free coding method, the proposed method can achieve the complete removal of dynamic false contour (DFC) and but it can minimize the error in gray scale rendition (GSR) by adaptively adjusting subfield weight depending on the cumulative histogram of the given image.

articleTitle: TVGuide2.0: Applying the Web2.0 fundamentals to IDTV
publicationTitle: 2009 Digest of Technical Papers International Conference on Consumer Electronics
abstract: In this paper we introduce our experiences in applying the Web 2.0 philosophy to build a TV guide system for IDTV platforms. Based on collaboration among subscribers, who give their opinion about TV content to implicitly build a folksonomy, the TV guide obtains personalized recommendations and allows users to browse among the multimedia content.

articleTitle: Foot motion tracking for motion capture from stereo cameras
publicationTitle: 2009 Digest of Technical Papers International Conference on Consumer Electronics
abstract: This paper proposes a new motion capture strategy to track foot motion from stereo cameras. We demonstrate motion capture of 3D foot model in real-time and show the performances of the proposed algorithm for the rotation and the translation of 3D foot models.

articleTitle: An extension of J.83 annex b transmission systems for Ultra-High Definition (UD) television broadcasting
publicationTitle: 2009 Digest of Technical Papers International Conference on Consumer Electronics
abstract: This paper presents the potential of ultra-high definition (UD), which has 16 times the definition of high definition (HD), cable television broadcasting. We assume that future audio and video codec technology, viz. H.265, provides approximately a 25% bit rate savings for equivalent quality over MPEG-2. About 80 Mbps is required per UD service, but this exceeds the Shannon capacity for a 6 MHz channel. Hence, we study the potential of UD transmission via two TV channels, to achieve both a satisfactory bit rate and threshold of visibility.

articleTitle: Dynamic self reconfigurable mobile platform for multimodal life log signal
publicationTitle: 2009 Digest of Technical Papers International Conference on Consumer Electronics
abstract: This paper proposes a dynamic self reconfigurable mobile platform which can collect, process, and transmit multimodal life log signal. The proposed platform provides highly reconfigurable schemes in 3 levels such as device, network, and application levels. The platform consists of a base module and optional device modules. This optional device module provides the device level reconfigurability. The platform constructs body area networks with other platforms using a near field communication device on the base module. It supports self reconfigurable scheme in network level because of its mobile characteristic. Applications running on the proposed platform depend on the device modules on the main module. The application reconfigurability results from the device level reconfigurability. We have implemented the proposed platform and verified its dynamic self reconfigurable scheme in multimodal life log signal processing.

articleTitle: Efficient quasi-lossless image compression for memory bandwidth reduction
publicationTitle: 2009 Digest of Technical Papers International Conference on Consumer Electronics
abstract: This paper proposes an efficient quasi-lossless image compression for the memory bandwidth reduction in the image processing chip application. The proposed algorithm combines a directional predictor with a modified Golumb-Rice (GR) coder to implement basic lossless compression scheme, and adds a rate control scheme by quantizing the directional prediction error. The rate control scheme monitors actual amount of compressed bit-stream and enables the quantizer as the bit rates approaches to target rates. The proposed method shows that it can achieve more than 50% bandwidth reduction without loss of image quality.

articleTitle: Fast block motion estimation using 4-level absolute difference
publicationTitle: 2009 Digest of Technical Papers International Conference on Consumer Electronics
abstract: To reduce the computational load of motion estimation, we propose a method of achieving higher accuracy compared to the existing low-bit based methods by calculating the 4-level absolute difference between two 2-bit images through the use of combinational logic circuit instead of absolute difference operation with the arithmetic-logic unit.

articleTitle: A study on efficient cooperative reception scheme of one segment ISDB-T
publicationTitle: 2009 Digest of Technical Papers International Conference on Consumer Electronics
abstract: The bandwidth of one segment ISDB-T is much narrower than the 13 segments ISDB-T and it is more severely affected by frequency dip affected by multi-path than the 13 segments ISDB-T. Although diversity techniques are effective scheme to improve reception characteristics under multi-path channels, the geometrically small size of one segment ISDB-T receivers restricts diversity gain under insufficient level. In order to improve this problem, cooperative reception between several receivers using a dedicated communication network is effective. In this paper, an efficient scheme of cooperative reception is proposed.

articleTitle: A diversity system for mobile reception of digital terrestrial television broadcasting
publicationTitle: 2009 Digest of Technical Papers International Conference on Consumer Electronics
abstract: In this paper, we propose a diversity system for mobile reception of digital terrestrial television broadcasting to solve the problem which a performance of maximum ratio combining (MRC) might become worse than that of single reception. The problem could occur at a certain situation which an input signal level from an antenna is much lower than one another. To solve the problem, in our diversity system, we introduce a new measure for deciding if a diversity gain is big enough. We have developed a diversity LSI and evaluate the proposed method. The experimental result shows our method improves the performance, in the case when input signal levels are very different.

articleTitle: CMOS implementation of Tx/Rx chains of a MB-OFDM based UWB system
publicationTitle: 2009 Digest of Technical Papers International Conference on Consumer Electronics
abstract: In this paper we present a hardware architecture for a multiband OFDM (MBOA) ultra wide band (UWB) transceiver designed with double data paths. The design minimizes the use of memories and is able to work with a unique clock frequency or with two clock domains. In the second case, it consumes less power and can be implemented with less expensive technologies. The proposed transceiver has been synthesized for a 120 nm CMOS technology.

articleTitle: Improved AACS framework for private digital contents
publicationTitle: 2009 Digest of Technical Papers International Conference on Consumer Electronics
abstract: AACS (Advanced Access Content System) has been developed for preventing the piracy of digital contents using broadcast encryption scheme. AACS distinguishes just privileged devices from revoked devices. However, it isn't sufficient for protecting private digital contents created by general consumers who want to keep their private contents using recordable Medias like DVD. This paper presents an improved AACS framework for private digital contents recorded on Media. The proposed framework additionally guarantees that general consumers can indicate playback devices when they record their own contents on Media so that the only devices can play the contents.

articleTitle: A 3D SPIHT low-memory encoding approach for video compression
publicationTitle: 2009 Digest of Technical Papers International Conference on Consumer Electronics
abstract: In this paper, a three-dimensional (3D) SPIHT algorithm is proposed with low-memory usage. The standard SPIHT coding uses three separate lists to store and organize tree data structures and their significance, which can grow large at high rate and consume large amounts of memory. In the proposed algorithm, unnecessary lists are discarded and the process length of the sorting phase is shortened to reduce coding time and memory usage. Results show that the proposed method reduces memory usage, run time and improves PSNR.

articleTitle: Car navigation system with image recognition
publicationTitle: 2009 Digest of Technical Papers International Conference on Consumer Electronics
abstract: Many cars now have on-board cameras, and many kinds of driver support systems that use image recognition are being developed. We developed a car navigation system with image recognition that enhances drivers' safety, convenience, and entertainment.

articleTitle: A silicon RF tuner for multi-standard digital terrestrial reception
publicationTitle: 2009 Digest of Technical Papers International Conference on Consumer Electronics
abstract: This paper presents a fully integrated multi-standard CMOS RF Tuner for portable and stationary digital terrestrial applications. Providing high linearity and dynamic range together with a very low part count it facilitates further cost reduction compared to conventional CAN Tuner implementations.

articleTitle: Loss-aware rate-distortion optimization for redundant picture allocation in H.264/AVC
publicationTitle: 2009 Digest of Technical Papers International Conference on Consumer Electronics
abstract: Redundant picture is one of H.264/AVC tools for increasing error resiliency when video is delivered over error prone environments. In this paper, we present a modified loss-aware rate-distortion optimization (LA-RDO) model considering overhead bits and loss rate of redundant coded pictures. Based on the proposed RD model, we determine whether each redundant picture is inserted, or not. Simulation results showed that our proposed method improved the average PSNR around 0.5 dB compared to hierarchical redundant picture (HRP). Our method works especially well at low-bitrate, so the method can be applied to low-bitrate wireless transmission environments.

articleTitle: CleveRemote Adaptive environments using Bluetooth/infrared transceivers
publicationTitle: 2009 Digest of Technical Papers International Conference on Consumer Electronics
abstract: This paper describes a new concept of a location-based remote control. This device analysis the user location and preferences to adapt the environment according to the customer needs. It makes the operation of the remote control easier and more pleasant.

articleTitle: Context driven web applications for networked DTV
publicationTitle: 2009 Digest of Technical Papers International Conference on Consumer Electronics
abstract: With the explosive growth and ubiquity of the Internet, consumers are experiencing the benefits of accessing a large amount of digital information. The trend is evolving to include net-enabled DTVs in addition to PCs and mobile phones. Latest DTVs can support advanced networking and rendering functions useful to access and display a variety of Web content and information in addition to traditional TV. The DTV however presents particular usability problems and obstacles that in many cases result in bad user experience as demonstrated by multiple failed attempts to introduce Web browsers in consumer AV devices. In this paper we summarize the key problems and challenges and propose as solution a context aware method to select Web mini applications that provide customized content and information. Our method improves usability when compared with other methods based on Web browsers or walled garden portals and provides compelling personalized content by taking into account consumer preferences and behavior.

articleTitle: Provision of the expressive multisensory adaptation for heterogeneous multimedia devices in the ubiquitous home
publicationTitle: 2009 Digest of Technical Papers International Conference on Consumer Electronics
abstract: This paper presents a multimedia service platform to express multisensory media effects for heterogeneous appliances and a home server in the ubiquitous home networks. The platform is equipped with an adaptation to process multimedia service based on a home server. The proposed adaptation consists of a multimedia parser, analyzer, device profile gatherer, device selector and media player. The adaptation communicates with service modules for integrating the control of various home appliances. The multimedia service supports not only multimedia contents subscriptions but also presents additional sensory effects to the high quality multimedia services for various different homes via the adaptation.

articleTitle: FMO bitrate overhead reducing for High Definition Video streaming over packet networks
publicationTitle: 2009 Digest of Technical Papers International Conference on Consumer Electronics
abstract: The transmission of High Definition Video (HDV) has to confront large size video packets due to the high resolution of video frames. The usage of Flexible Macroblock Ordering (FMO) to control the size of video packets for different network types causes bitrate overhead. In this paper, we propose an improved FMO algorithm that can efficiently reduce the bitrate overhead. In the proposed algorithm, all MBs are grouped in SGs based on the similarity of the transformation coefficients. Experimental results show that our algorithm can reduce the bitrate overhead significantly as compared with conventional FMOs.

articleTitle: A fast image fusion algorithm for image stabilization on hand-held consumer electronics
publicationTitle: 2009 Digest of Technical Papers International Conference on Consumer Electronics
abstract: This paper proposes an efficient approach to image fusion for image stabilization, suitable to hand-held consumer electronics applications. To assure image stabilization, we synthesize a good quality image by fusing several short-exposed degraded dark images of the same scene. Due to the low computational power on hand-held consumer electronics, we take the computational efficiency as the main design factor to elaborately redesign each procedure of the conventional image fusion algorithms. The experimental results reveal that our approach is not only executed efficiently but also capable of generating good quality images.

articleTitle: A noise robust content-based music retrieval system
publicationTitle: 2009 Digest of Technical Papers International Conference on Consumer Electronics
abstract: In this paper, we constructed the noise robust content-based music retrieval system. The performance of the proposed system was verified with ZCPA feature, which is known to have noise robust characteristic in speech recognition application. In addition, new indexing and fast retrieval method were proposed to improve retrieval speed about 99% compare to exhaustive retrieval for large music DB. From the computer simulation results in noise environment of 15dB − 0dB SNR, we confirmed the superior performance of the proposed system about 5% – 30% compared to MFCC and FBE (filter bank energy).

articleTitle: Image quality comparison between 3CCD pixel shift technology and single-sensor CFA demosaicking
publicationTitle: 2009 Digest of Technical Papers International Conference on Consumer Electronics
abstract: This paper investigates the performance differences in taking measure of the difference in total pixel count between the 1.5M-pixel 3CCD with pixel shift technology and the 2M-pixel single image sensor using CFA demosaicking for full HD video capture in terms of image quality and color artifacts.

articleTitle: A rate control technique for H.264/AVC using subjective quality of 2D/3D video
publicationTitle: 2009 Digest of Technical Papers International Conference on Consumer Electronics
abstract: This paper proposes an intelligent rate control technique for H.264/AVC using subjective quality of 2D/3D video. A subjective Video Quality Metric (VQM) is used with an Evolution Strategy algorithm, which is capable of identifying the best possible quantization parameters for each frame/macroblock to encode the video sequence such that it would maximize the subjective quality of the entire 2D/3D video sequence subjected to the target bit rate. Simulation results show that up to 35% bit rate saving can be achieved with the proposed technique at the same video quality.

articleTitle: Performance of the pipe-base d transmission system in the real field
publicationTitle: 2009 Digest of Technical Papers International Conference on Consumer Electronics
abstract: We have developed a new pipe-based transmission system, which utilizes a pair of refrigerant pipes of the air conditioner. Field examination of the pipe-based transmission system on the pipeline of existing air-conditioning equipments in a building has been completed. In this paper describes the field test results, such as bit error ratio and physical transmission rates and radiated electric field at the out side of the building. We have confirmed the pipe-based transmission system has practical reliability for the control system through the field test.
